subject: Air freight quote to RUH
body:
Hi,

Please quote your fastest air freight option to RUH (Riyadh, SA), including truck pickup from our site in 40737 (Duesseldorf), Germany. The shipment is ready for pickup on 2026-11-25.

Electronic control units: 4 pieces, 990 kg gross, 5.75 cbm. Please send your all-in price in EUR.

For your orientation: another forwarder has already offered us about 1620 EUR all-in for this shipment.

Sara
Lindqvist Medtech
